system.description: Each level stocks two catalogue entries — potions, elixirs and the period-renamed preparations (Sal Volatile, Liniment, Coca Elixir, Quinine Wine, Carbolic Preparation, Steadying Drops, Antitoxin…), created and used via the Inventory action. Vinum Ferri prints a duplicated effect — named, unusable until errata.
